title: AgentLintel Conformance Fixture Expected Output
description: Declares the violations a AgentLintel-compatible verifier should produce for a fixture case.

violations.description: Empty array means the case must produce no violations for the rule under test.

file.description: Path relative to the case root, using forward slashes.

line.description: Optional 1-based line number. Omit for line-agnostic checks.

message_contains.description: Optional substring the verifier's message must contain. Case-sensitive.
